alt: Asadullah Imran at UIU UGA Student Counseling and Collaboration Space
description: Selected to support faculty and mentor undergraduate students across core Computer Science and Engineering curriculum laboratory courses.
responsibilities: Assisted instructors in conducting lab sessions for undergraduate CSE courses (Programming, Data Structures, Algorithms, OS, Database, etc.).
Helped students debug code, grasp abstract computer science concepts, and complete rigorous lab tasks.
Evaluated lab assignments, quizzes, and course project submissions with detailed actionable feedback.
Supported faculty with classroom management, lab environment setup, and technical troubleshooting.
Provided one-on-one academic support to struggling students through scheduled counseling hours.
highlights: Active contributor at the UGA Student Counseling & Collaboration Space, fostering peer learning, knowledge exchange, and academic mentorship.

description: Promoted to Associate in the Development Wing, leading technical web initiatives and mentoring peers.

timeline.details: Promoted to Associate in the Development Wing to lead frontend and full-stack projects, design architectural solutions, and support university hackathons and events.
Active club member participating in competitive programming events, technical workshops, and peer community projects.
